description: Record what a person thought of something the agent produced — a reply, an export, a report, an email. Send it as soon as they press the thumb: the reason and their words are optional and may follow in a second call, which replaces the first. Pick `reason_code` from get_feedback_reasons; an unknown code is dropped and the rating is still saved (`reason_dropped: true`). For `target_kind: "report"` the `target_ref` is the view_key, NOT the report_key — one report is read by many country pages and only the view_key tells them apart. `target_ref` is verified against your own message log: the answer carries `ref_check` saying whether it matched (`verified`), did not (`mismatch`), could not be checked (`unchecked`) or was never sent (`absent`). A rating is never dropped because the check failed.

comment.description: Their own words. Optional. Trimmed at 2000 characters.

knowledge_ids.description: Ids of the platform rules that were in the prompt for this answer, up to 50. This is how a harmful rule gets noticed from a single complaint.

model.description: Which model produced the rated answer.

probe.description: True when the call comes from a test run rather than a person. 🔴 Derive it from the process you run in — do not set it by hand: a flag someone has to remember is a flag someone forgets. The rating is still STORED; it is hidden behind a switch on the triage screen, because dropping it on arrival would lose what later needs explaining. Omit the field when you cannot tell — absent means "not stated", never "a person".

reason_shown_lang.description: Language the person actually SAW the reason card in — send it together with `reason_code`, never alone. It exists so that "they picked this reason" can be told apart from "they tapped something they could not read": when the card had not been translated yet, the language differs from the visitor locale. Omit the field entirely rather than sending an empty string — absent means "not stated", which is a different answer from "in their own language".

signal.description: thumb (default) for a pressed thumb; undone when they cancelled the result; rephrased or left for the quiet signals. The weight is set by the platform, not by you.

target_kind.description: What was rated: answer | export | report | email | any future kind.

target_ref.description: Your identifier of the rated work: the message id for an answer, the view_key for a report. Omit it only when the kind has none.

topic.description: What the exchange was about, one short phrase.

verdict.description: The thumb the person pressed. Send "retracted" (or an empty string) when they pressed the same thumb again and took the rating back — it then stops counting and leaves the triage queue. Retracting needs the same target_ref as the rating it undoes.

name: rate_agent_result
title: Rate the agent
